issues.body: When the inverter reports more power than the house uses, the charger should start and follow the surplus.

issues.title: The app shows the wrong state of charge after a reconnect
issues.body: After the car reconnects, the app keeps the value from before until the next poll. Seen while testing the surplus charging of #1.

issues.title: Plan charging to be ready by a departure time
issues.body: Given a departure time and a target state of charge, charge in the cheapest hours that still reach it. It builds on the surplus charging of #1.

issues.body: Every topic the charger publishes, with its unit.

# Sparkplug

Sparkplug charges an electric car from what the roof makes. Surplus charging came with #1, and departure planning is #3.

See [the configuration](docs/configuration.md). Install it as the [installation guide](https://docs.sparkplug.example/en/docs/install) says; the [chargers](https://docs.sparkplug.example/en/docs/devices/chargers) are listed on the site.

Known problem: [a stale value after reconnecting](https://github.com/dynamo-sample/sparkplug/issues/2).

# Configuration

The charger, the inverter and the car are set in `sparkplug.yaml`.

## Topics

The MQTT topics are still to be written down (#4).

# MQTT topics

Every topic the charger publishes, with its unit, as asked in #4. Where each is set is in [the configuration](configuration.md#topics).

# Changelog

## 1.0

- Charge from surplus solar power (#1).

---
title: Installing Sparkplug
---
Put `sparkplug.yaml` next to the binary; [the configuration](https://github.com/dynamo-sample/sparkplug/blob/main/docs/configuration.md) says what goes in it.

---
title: Questions
---
Sparkplug starts charging once the surplus has lasted a minute; see [installing](/en/docs/install/).
